profile.professional_summary: Junior data scientist with 14 months of hands-on experience in Python, SQL, statistical analysis, customer churn classification and controlled-experiment evaluation. Built reproducible scikit-learn and XGBoost notebooks, evaluated classification models with held-out data, and communicated uncertainty to product teams. Limited production ML and cloud infrastructure experience.

projects.name: Subscription Churn Modeling
projects.summary: Built supervised classification baselines and an XGBoost model for synthetic subscription-retention data with leakage-aware train/test evaluation.
highlights: Created features with pandas and SQL extracts and compared baselines.
Used stratified holdout validation, precision-recall analysis, and calibration checks.
Documented errors, data leakage risks and decision-threshold tradeoffs.

projects.name: Checkout Experiment Analysis
projects.summary: Analyzed an A/B product experiment, investigating conversion differences and uncertainty in user-behavior data.
highlights: Defined experiment metrics and validated allocation and missingness.
Estimated treatment effects and confidence intervals and presented limitations.

job.title: Graduate Data Scientist - Experimentation
job.description: Use Python, SQL and statistics to design and analyze product A/B tests. Define trustworthy success metrics, diagnose allocation issues, estimate treatment effects and communicate confidence intervals. Hybrid in Munich; graduate candidates are welcome.

jobs.notes: Direct match to the candidate experiment-analysis project and statistical communication evidence.

job.title: Junior Data Scientist - Data Quality
job.description: Use Python and pandas to clean large customer datasets, automate data-quality tests, write SQL extracts and occasionally support classification-model evaluation. Most work is data preparation, not training models. Remote within Germany.

jobs.notes: Hard constraints pass and skills transfer, but day-to-day work is predominantly preparation.

job.title: Junior Applied Data Scientist
job.description: Build reproducible Python predictive models using pandas, scikit-learn and gradient boosting. Review class imbalance, leakage risks and error analysis with stakeholders. Fully remote within Germany.

jobs.notes: Direct applied modeling and validation role within the demonstrated technical scope.

job.title: Junior Data Scientist - Product Analytics
job.description: Apply Python, pandas and statistical tests to product experiments for a hybrid team located in Paris.

jobs.notes: Otherwise suitable data-science opening in a non-preferred location; hybrid does not confer Germany-wide remote eligibility.

job.title: Junior Data Scientist - Enterprise Analytics
job.description: Build Python analytics workflows and support SAP reporting integrations alongside scikit-learn evaluations. Hybrid in Berlin.

jobs.notes: Otherwise eligible but explicitly includes the persona-excluded technology.

job.title: Senior Data Scientist - Classification
job.description: Lead Python scikit-learn model development and statistical evaluation for classification systems. Mentor junior data scientists and own senior architecture decisions. Hybrid in Berlin.

jobs.notes: Otherwise suitable role, but explicitly senior rather than junior or graduate.

job.title: Junior Data Analyst - Product Experiments
job.description: Investigate product conversion funnels using SQL and Python. Validate A/B test results, present confidence intervals and maintain stakeholder dashboards. The main responsibility is analytical reporting rather than predictive model development. Hybrid in Berlin.

jobs.notes: Strong experimentation overlap; data-analyst responsibilities offer less direct model-development work.

job.title: Junior BI Dashboard Developer
job.description: Build interactive business-intelligence dashboards with Python export scripts, SQL and visualization software. This is a visualization-development opening rather than a data-science or data-analyst position. Hybrid in Berlin.

jobs.notes: Adjacent data skills but the vacancy title does not match either declared target-role family.

job.title: Junior Data Scientist - Model Review Operations
job.description: Review outputs produced by an existing Python classification pipeline, check data samples for consistency, write SQL quality queries and escalate model errors to a separate modeling team. No new model training is expected. Hybrid in Hamburg.

jobs.notes: Attractive job title and terminology, but limited ownership of analysis or modeling.

job.title: Junior Data Analyst - R Reporting
job.description: Perform statistical analyses with R, tidyverse and SQL. Maintain R Markdown reporting pipelines; the team exclusively uses its existing R tooling. Remote within Germany.

jobs.notes: Role and location fit, but the required candidate-stack keyword is absent from all searchable job fields.

job.title: Junior Data Analyst - Dashboard Migration
job.description: Migrate dashboards and rewrite report definitions in a new BI tool. Read existing Python, pandas, scikit-learn and XGBoost model summaries supplied by another team when reproducing dashboard labels; no experimentation, statistical analysis, or model development is part of the role. Hybrid in Berlin.

jobs.notes: Deliberate lexical decoy: core skills appear in the description and tags, but duties are dashboard migration only.

job.title: Junior Data Scientist - Customer Modeling
job.description: Develop churn classifiers with Python, pandas and scikit-learn. Compare XGBoost against transparent baselines, investigate leakage and evaluate precision-recall tradeoffs. Present uncertainty to a subscription product team. Hybrid in Berlin; English is the working language.

jobs.notes: Strong direct role and skills fit: supervised churn modeling and evaluation are demonstrated by the candidate.

job.title: Junior Data Scientist - Forecasting
job.description: Use Python, pandas and statistics for retail demand forecasting. Compare time-series baselines and communicate forecast uncertainty; familiarity with specialized forecasting methods is helpful. Hybrid in Hamburg.

jobs.notes: Relevant modeling and statistical work but specialized time-series experience is not established.

job.title: Junior Data Scientist - Client Analytics
job.description: Analyze client behavior with Python, SQL and scikit-learn. German C1 proficiency is mandatory for client-facing analysis, workshops and written results. Hybrid in Munich.

jobs.notes: Hard requirement for German C1 exceeds the candidate German B1 level.

job.title: Junior Analytics Scientist
job.description: Analyze customer cohorts with Python and SQL, apply statistical tests, build lightweight predictive baselines using scikit-learn and explain the results to product teams. Hybrid in Munich.

jobs.notes: Data-scientist alias recognized by existing ROLE_ALIASES; moderate predictive work and strong statistics overlap.

job.title: Junior Data Scientist - Short Contract
job.description: Develop Python models and SQL experiments for clients through a six-month contractor-only engagement. Fully remote within Germany.

jobs.notes: Matches technical domain but contractor-only employment violates the full-time preference.

job.title: Junior Data Scientist - Onsite Team
job.description: Develop Python classification models and support A/B experiments. The position requires five days each week onsite in Hamburg with no remote or hybrid option.

jobs.notes: Otherwise suitable but explicitly onsite only; tests the existing negated work-mode regression.

job.title: Junior Data Analyst - Business Reporting
job.description: Create recurring SQL reports, use Python and pandas for ad hoc data extracts, and prepare charts for weekly stakeholder meetings. Statistical inference and model development are uncommon. Remote across Germany.

jobs.notes: Compatible target role with transferable data skills but routine reporting dominates.

job.title: Junior Data Analyst - Retention Insights
job.description: Own retention dashboards and exploratory analysis using Python, pandas, SQL and Matplotlib. Occasionally evaluate retention interventions with simple A/B testing; predictive-model development belongs to another team. Hybrid in Berlin.

jobs.notes: Excellent analytics skill overlap and some experimentation, but no substantive modeling ownership.

job.title: Junior Data Scientist - Administrative Operations
job.description: Despite the title, this position mainly schedules recurring data deliveries, updates spreadsheets and handles coordination tickets. Python is used only for occasional one-off export scripts; there is no modeling or experiment analysis. Hybrid role based in Munich.

jobs.notes: Passes hard constraints using explicit hybrid text despite unknown provider remote flag; misleading title, almost no analysis.
